name: @blockbase/cli
description: Blockbase command line: catalog, agent installs, MCP and the local catalog page.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @blockbase/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/core build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/mcp build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-agent-payload.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @blockbase/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/core build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/mcp build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
